context_requirements: Functional GABAA receptor signaling machinery; most of these lines are not neuronal and may lack sufficient receptor subunit expression.
Membrane depolarization or calcium influx may be required for downstream transcriptional effects, which is unlikely in non-excitable cells.
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of immediate-early genes (e.g., FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h across multiple lines.
Consistent dose-dependent transcriptional changes at 10 micromolar in any of the nine lines.
Enrichment of GABA-receptor-related gene expression changes at 24 h.
